summary: Sanofi filed a 6-K announcing the appointment of Belén Garijo as Director and CEO at its April 29, 2026 Annual General Meeting, effective May 1, 2026. She succeeds Paul Hudson, whose departure is part of a Board-led transition. The filing details shareholder approvals, dividend declaration of €4.12/share, and board composition updates. No financial terms or premiums are involved. The change is a planned succession, not a routine proxy, and represents a material leadership event warranting classification as Management Changes.
